_readme: One entry per SETTLED benchmark alert in oracle/benchmark/benchmark_predictions.jsonl. status: clean | corrupt | unclassified. Read this before quoting any benchmark mean. Benchmark rows are NOT edited by this file.
_rule: corrupt = median share of neutral facilities over the alert window >= 20% (measured gap: clean <= 8%, corrupt 45-64%). Source of the measurement: see CORRUPT_INPUT_FIX_2026-10-20.md.
_caveat: The map-snapshot archive used for the measurement is NOT in this repo (only oracle/backend/data/map_snapshots/1/4/2026-10-18.jsonl). 'clean' rows are therefore taken on trust from the fix doc. Open question: the 22 corrupt rows are all Meltdown/Oshur event ids; a Meltdown lock looks the same in the data. See the fix doc, section 'Open question'.
